install: npm install && { command -v turnserver >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y coturn; }; } && { command -v cloudflared >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo mkdir -p --mode=0755 /usr/share/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://pkg.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-main.gpg | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare-main.gpg >/dev/null && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare-main.gpg] https://pkg.cloudflare.com/cloudflared any main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cloudflared.list >/dev/null && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y cloudflared; }; }
